citations.assessment: Meir suggests that Natan ask Rabban Shimon ben Gamliel to teach Uktzin. The pinned Bavli names the sage ben Kodshai and places him behind the upper room. Retain the compiler’s different wording about the window and his two name forms.
The local Natan dossier names his judicial office under Rabban Shimon ben Gamliel and his association with R. Meir.
The Midrash has the cognate form bar Korshoi, independently of the Bavli’s ben Kodshai.
The cited dossier names this teacher. It separately qualifies the identification of bare Yaakov in the Mishnah.
